title: Artificial intelligence outperforms standard blood-based scores in identifying liver fibrosis patients in primary care.
summary: Ensemble models using routine clinical data were evaluated for identifying clinically significant liver fibrosis in primary care, against standard blood-based scores. External replication and prospective utility were not established in the reviewed material.
